lines.text: If Israel obeys the LORD, He will set them high above all the nations of the earth.
Israel will be blessed in the city and the country, and their basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
Enemies who march out against Israel in one direction will flee from them in twelve.
The LORD will establish Israel as His holy people, and all peoples will stand in awe of them.
The LORD will open the heavens to send manna on their land in season.
